body.zh-Hant: 林德曼1862年9月19日生於厄斯特爾布魯克（Österbybruk），1876年入海軍學校當學員，1882年10月18日任海軍少尉。他1889年離開海軍，轉到伊格松德（Iggesund）鋼鐵廠任職，自1892年10月起任該廠董事總經理，至1903年。1900年2月1日起他出任基律納瓦拉—盧奧薩瓦拉礦業公司（LKAB）總經理，到1901年春。1904年10月7日他轉任電報總局局長，任到1907年12月。
body.en: Lindman was born on 19 September 1862 at Österbybruk, entered the naval cadet school in 1876 and became a sub-lieutenant in the navy on 18 October 1882. In 1889 he left the naval career for the Iggesund ironworks, of which he was managing director from October 1892 until 1903. From 1 February 1900 he was managing director of the Luossavaara-Kiirunavaara company (LKAB) until spring 1901, and from 7 October 1904 he was director-general of the telegraph administration until December 1907.

heading.zh-Hant: 上議院、海軍部長與首任首相
heading.en: Upper chamber, naval minister and first premiership

body.zh-Hant: 林德曼1905至1911年是上議院議員。1905年8月2日至11月6日，他在隆德貝里內閣出任海軍部長。1906年5月29日他出任首相，在位到1911年10月6日；傳記辭典記載，這個內閣在約五年半任期內提出一千一百多件議案，其中的憲政改革使男子在下議院選舉中獲得普遍選舉權。1911年下議院選舉受挫後，內閣下台。丹麥的 Lex 條目同樣記他1906至1911年領導政府。
body.en: Lindman sat in the upper chamber from 1905 to 1911. From 2 August to 6 November 1905 he was minister of naval defence in the Lundeberg cabinet. On 29 May 1906 he became prime minister and served until 6 October 1911; the biographical dictionary records that this cabinet submitted more than 1,100 bills in about five and a half years, and that a constitutional reform brought universal male suffrage to elections for the second chamber. After the setback in the 1911 elections to the second chamber the government resigned. The Danish Lex entry likewise says he headed a government in 1906-1911.

body.zh-Hant: 1912年起他領導下議院的右派黨團，直到1935年6月；1913年他又成為地主與市民黨（lantmanna- och borgarepartiet）的主席。1917年3月30日至10月18日，他在斯瓦茨（Carl Swartz）內閣擔任外交大臣；1917年10月艾登—布蘭廷政府上台。傳記辭典稱1918年之後的十年是他作為黨領袖的高峰。
body.en: From 1912 he led the right-wing group of the second chamber until June 1935, and in 1913 he became chairman of the Farmers' and Burghers' Party (lantmanna- och borgarepartiet). From 30 March to 18 October 1917 he was minister for foreign affairs in the Swartz cabinet; in October 1917 the Edén-Branting government took office. The dictionary calls the decade after 1918 the high point of his career as a party leader.

body.zh-Hant: 1928年10月2日林德曼再度出任首相，組成少數派政府，任到1930年6月6日；特里格（Trygger）出任他的外交大臣。1930年他在國會就穀物關稅一案敗北後辭職。1935年右派的兩個議會黨團合併，他成為合併後黨團的首任主席；之後他卸下全國選舉人聯盟（AVF）主席並離開國會。丹麥的 Lex 條目記他1936年12月9日卒於英國克羅伊登。
body.en: On 2 October 1928 Lindman again became prime minister, heading a minority government until 6 June 1930; Trygger was his foreign minister. In 1930 he resigned after a defeat in the Riksdag over grain tariffs. In 1935 the two right-wing parliamentary groups merged and he became the first chairman of the merged group; he then stepped down as chairman of the General Electoral League (AVF) and left the Riksdag. The Danish Lex entry records that he died at Croydon in England on 9 December 1936.

body.zh-Hant: 岡薩雷斯·弗洛雷斯1877年6月15日生於埃雷迪亞（Heredia），1896年自哥斯大黎加中學（Liceo de Costa Rica）畢業；1898年他到英國旅行，對經濟學產生興趣。他在法學院取得律師資格，1902年9月1日加入律師公會。他是多明戈·岡薩雷斯·佩雷斯（Domingo González Pérez）的兒子。
body.en: Alfredo González Flores was born in Heredia on 15 June 1877 and graduated from the Liceo de Costa Rica in 1896; in 1898 he travelled to Great Britain, where he became interested in economics. He qualified as a lawyer at the law school and joined the Bar Association on 1 September 1902. He was the son of Domingo González Pérez.

heading.en: Deputy and the road to the presidency

body.zh-Hant: 1905年他在選戰中支持馬克西莫·費爾南德斯（Máximo Fernández）的候選資格；1910至1914年他是埃雷迪亞省的共和黨（Partido Republicano）議員，他提出的抵押銀行案獲國會通過，卻被總統里卡多·希門尼斯否決。他由國會選為第一副總統（Primer Designado）。穆里略的論文記載，蒂諾科與共和黨人促成的協議於1914年4月28日達成，他在5月8日走出炮兵營房就任總統。
body.en: In 1905 he took part in the campaign backing Máximo Fernández; from 1910 to 1914 he was a deputy of the Republican Party for Heredia province, and a mortgage-bank bill he proposed was passed by Congress but vetoed by President Ricardo Jiménez Oreamuno. Congress elected him First Designate to the presidency. Murillo's article records that the agreement brokered by Tinoco and the Republicans was reached on 28 April 1914 and that he left the artillery barracks to take office as president on 8 May.

body.zh-Hant: 任總統期間，他在1914年創設國際銀行（Banco Internacional），作為國家發行銀行，並大膽提議徵收所得稅，以減輕窮人的困境。他的任期是1914年5月8日至1917年1月27日，選舉法庭的歷任總統表記載，國家博物館的條目則記他為1914至1917年的總統。1917年1月27日他的戰爭部長費德里科·蒂諾科（Federico Tinoco）發動政變推翻他；之後他說服美國總統威爾遜不承認蒂諾科政權。
body.en: As president he founded the Banco Internacional in 1914 as the state's issuing bank and boldly proposed an income tax to ease the hardship of the poor. The Electoral Tribunal's list of presidents places his term from 8 May 1914 to 27 January 1917, and the National Museum entry gives it as 1914 to 1917. On 27 January 1917 his Minister of War, Federico Tinoco, overthrew him in a coup; he then persuaded US President Woodrow Wilson not to recognise the Tinoco regime.

body.zh-Hant: 他1917至1920年流亡美國；1918年5月他在紐約公開一項法令，把總統職位託付給任內的第三副總統弗朗西斯科·阿吉拉爾·巴爾克羅（Francisco Aguilar Barquero）。1920年他出版《石油與哥斯大黎加的政治》，1923年擔任哥斯大黎加在對英國訴訟（蒂諾科案）中的律師。1936年他被任命為國家銀行董事會主席，1940年因健康辭職。1954年7月25日他獲封「國家功勳」（Benemérito de la Patria）；他於1962年去世。
body.en: He was in exile in the United States from 1917 to 1920. In May 1918, from New York, he made public a decree depositing the presidency with the Third Designate of his government, Francisco Aguilar Barquero. In 1920 he published El petróleo y la política de Costa Rica, and in 1923 he was Costa Rica's lawyer in the litigation against Great Britain (the Tinoco case). In 1936 he was named chairman of the board of the Banco Nacional, resigning in 1940 for health reasons. On 25 July 1954 he was declared Benemérito de la Patria; he died in 1962.

people.nameZh: 尼塞托·阿爾卡拉-薩莫拉

body.zh-Hant: 阿爾卡拉—薩莫拉1877年7月6日生於科爾多瓦省的普列戈（Priego de Córdoba）。他十七歲時已取得格拉納達大學的法學學位，二十二歲成為國務委員會的法律顧問。德國國家圖書館權威檔記他為西班牙政治家與法學家，生於1877年，是第二共和國的第一任國家元首。
body.en: Alcalá-Zamora was born on 6 July 1877 at Priego de Córdoba. By the age of seventeen he held a law degree from the University of Granada, and at twenty-two he became a legal adviser (letrado) of the Council of State. The German National Library authority record describes him as a Spanish politician and jurist, born in 1877, and the first head of state of the Second Republic.

heading.zh-Hant: 君主制時期的政治與學院

body.zh-Hant: 在君主制復辟時期，他屬於自由黨（Partido Liberal）。他在曼努埃爾·加西亞·普列托（Manuel García Prieto）主持的兩屆內閣裡，先後任公共工程（Fomento）部長（1917至1918年）和戰爭部長（1922至1923年）。1913年他獲准成為皇家法學與立法學院（Real Academia de Jurisprudencia y Legislación）的正式院士，1930年4月11日當選該院院長。
body.en: During the Restoration monarchy he belonged to the Liberal Party. In two cabinets presided over by Manuel García Prieto he served as minister of Fomento (1917-18) and minister of War (1922-23). In 1913 he was admitted as a full member of the Royal Academy of Jurisprudence and Legislation, and on 11 April 1930 he was elected its president.

body.zh-Hant: 他反對米格爾·普里莫·德里維拉的獨裁，1930年表態支持共和，參與聖塞瓦斯蒂安協定，並在阿方索十三世於1931年4月14日退位後領導臨時政府。他後來當選共和國總統；1931年11月26日他在第四次嘗試後獲選為西班牙皇家語言學院的正式院士。1936年4月7日他被免去總統職務。
body.en: Opposed to the dictatorship of Miguel Primo de Rivera, he declared himself in favour of the Republic in 1930, took part in the Pact of San Sebastián, and led the provisional government after Alfonso XIII renounced the throne on 14 April 1931. He was later elected president of the Republic. On 26 November 1931, at the fourth attempt, he was elected a full member of the Royal Spanish Academy. On 7 April 1936 he was removed from the presidency.

body.zh-Hant: 他於1949年2月18日凌晨在布宜諾斯艾利斯的流亡中去世。他留下大量著作，包括《憲法經驗三年》和《1931年憲法的缺陷》；1945年他在評述自己被免職一事時寫過文章。
body.en: He died in exile in Buenos Aires in the early morning of 18 February 1949. He left a large body of writings, including Tres años de experiencia constitucional and Los defectos de la Constitución de 1931; in 1945 he wrote a commentary on his removal from office.
